key_insight: Adaptive LLM routing can match or outperform the best single model for automated heuristic discovery without always relying on the largest, costliest model.
engineering_relevance: Ballad offers a way to reduce API spending while maintaining or improving heuristic quality in combinatorial optimization workflows.
method: Use online bandit routing to select an LLM at each search step, favoring rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable averages.
Propagate credit through a DAG representing the heuristic population’s genealogy.
Discount stale observations to track each model’s changing utility.
evidence_signal: Across five NP-hard optimization problems and four LLMs, Ballad matched the best individual model in hindsight, sometimes surpassed every individual model, and reduced API cost by up to 65.6% versus always using the strongest model.
watch_item: Results cover five problems and four models; performance and savings may differ with other model pools, pricing, or search budgets.
paper_title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
